assumptions_not_known: treats all endpoints as untrusted and hostile
tests boundary conditions and malformed RFC inputs

criteria.name: containment
criteria.evidence: evaluation/blind/panel_b/b4_red_team_log.md: Zero script execution; Bleach 6.1 allowlist strips <script>, onerror, javascript: protocols from DOM.
criteria.quote: XSS attack vectors fully contained without DOM injection.

criteria.name: error quality
criteria.evidence: Malformed MIME files return structured HTTP 400/422 responses with descriptive validation details.
criteria.quote: Predictable, typed error responses across edge cases.

criteria.name: graceful degradation
criteria.evidence: Null bytes and non-UTF8 byte sequences decoded with UTF-8 replacement characters rather than raising unhandled exceptions.
criteria.quote: Robust parser degradation when encountering adversarial encoding and RTLO glyphs.

criteria.name: UI resilience
criteria.evidence: UI maintains layout integrity even when encountering 100kb strings via CSS truncate / overflow-x containment.
criteria.quote: Dashboard remained fully interactive with zero UI freezing.

criteria.name: honesty of failure
criteria.evidence: Invalid email uploads produce user-visible error alerts without misleading success toasts.
criteria.quote: Failure feedback is transparent and informative.

top_finding: Bleach sanitization is strictly applied on body rendering; ensure raw header JSON viewer in modal escapes unprintable ASCII null bytes.
unanswered_question: Does the system scan password-protected ZIP attachments for nested recursive archive bombs?
